name: 321Movies UK
description: 321Movies UK — movies & TV series from 321movies.co.uk (TMDB catalog). Real HLS sources from the site's own player (Cascade, StreamAggregator, Surge, Movy…), each probed before it is offered; Hindi audio first.

name: CineFreak
description: CineFreak (cinefreak.net) — Hindi, English, dual-audio movies, web series & K-Drama. Direct 480p/720p/1080p files from the site's own player, with automatic stream preparation.

name: CineHD
description: CineHD (cinehd.vc) — movies & series from a TMDB catalog with many servers per title (MhPly/AwsPly Hindi, Nitro multi-audio, HDHub, Rock HLS, MovieBox, VidAPI…). Every link is checked before it is shown; Hindi first.

name: CineJoy
description: CineJoy (cinejoy.pk) — movies & series from a TMDB catalog (Netflix/Prime rows) with many servers per title: Nitro multi-audio, MhPly/AwsPly Hindi, HDHub, VidAPI, MovieBox, Rock HLS. Links are checked before they are shown.

name: FMoviess
description: FMoviess (fmoviess.tv) — HD movies & TV shows with Trending / Latest rows. MoviesAPI multi-quality HLS with subtitles, plus a VidAPI/MovieBox backup for titles MoviesAPI lacks (and VixSrc where reachable). Every link is checked before it is shown.

name: HiCine
description: HiCine (hicine.sbs) — Bollywood & Hollywood movies, web series, K-dramas and anime in Hindi dual-audio. Direct 1080p/720p/480p files on FSL, Server 1, FSL v2 and PixelDrain; plot, rating and backdrop from TMDB.

name: Hindi Dubbed
description: Hindi Dubbed — Hollywood & South Indian Hindi-dubbed movies, Bollywood and Hindi cartoons from 20 official YouTube channels (Goldmines, Aditya, Shemaroo, Ultra, Pen, Rajshri, B4U…). Full movies as single items, web series grouped with episodes. Search finds full movies only.

name: KDramaMaza
description: KDramaMaza (kdramasmaza.net) — Korean, Chinese, Turkish & Japanese dramas plus anime in Hindi/Urdu dub. Full episode lists with direct HubCloud and GDFlix (Instant / Drive) files, checked before they are shown.

name: KatMovieHD
description: KatMovieHD — Hollywood & web series in Hindi dubbed / dual audio. Movies in every posted quality (StreamTape, HubCloud, GDFlix Instant / Drive), series with full episode lists and other seasons merged in. Links are checked before they are shown.

name: NetMirror
description: NetMirror (netmirror.center) - Netflix-style catalog: Bollywood, Hollywood, Anime & Reality TV, heavy on Hindi content. Signed direct-file servers per title/episode (R2 + quality-labeled MP4s, up to 1080p). v6: fixed the install-time crash (a header constant called the geo helper before its constants existed) and the site domain now follows the selected mirror. v5: rate-limit friendly (top-3 links per server).

name: RiveStream
description: RiveStream (rivestream.ru) - "Your Personal Streaming Oasis". TMDB-powered catalog of movies & TV, streamed from rivestream's own Rive server backends (Citadel, Prvibd, River, Kutti, Gbru, HindiSk). Default audio: Hindi - Hindi-dubbed tracks are ranked first in the server list, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali. Verified live.

name: SSR Movies
description: SSR Movies - Hindi dubbed & dual audio movies, Bollywood, Hollywood, web series, WWE shows in 480p-4K. HubCloud + GDFlix download mirrors resolved to direct files

name: SubDubAnime
description: SubDubAnime (subdubanime.site) - Hindi & English dubbed/subbed anime: series, seasons and movies via the Blakite API. Direct HLS per episode (up to 1080p where available). Verified live. v3: hardened the TMDB metadata mapping - description/genre/score values are normalised, so one malformed upstream field can no longer fail the whole dashboard.

name: Vidbox
description: Vidbox (vidbox.vc) - TMDB-powered catalog of movies & TV using vidbox's own TMDB id space. Streams resolve through the Nxsha multi-language server. Hindi audio is ranked first, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali; every HLS/DASH manifest is verified before it is offered. v2: removed a dead duplicate stream function and fixed episode items (name/airDate) plus genre tags so they render in the app.
